{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.12
|gr1= Groups

|descr= Returns [[Group]] to which the given vehicle was added last with [[addVehicle]]. To update [[assignedGroup]] to the current group, run [[addVehicle]] to the current group again.

|s1= [[assignedGroup]] vehicle

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]] - transport

|r1= [[Group]]

|x1= <sqf>_group = assignedGroup vehicle player;</sqf>
